title: Canonical coefficient-unit smooth orientation family
statement: Let $P$ be a finite-field/coefficient purity setting, with $k=P.field.k$, prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$ and fixed coefficient closure. Work on separated finite-type $k$-schemes and smooth separated maps $f:X\to Y$ of pure relative dimension $d$, with their stipulated normalized operation systems. Use [def-pur-conventions], [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], [def-fix-six-functor-datum], [def-pur-finite-reduction-comparisons], [def-pur-canonical-rational-purity-realization], [def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports], [def-weil-site-perfect-complex] and [cor-pur-adic-and-rational-smooth-dualizing-complexes]. Define the literal finite-subfield coefficient index and its adapter to the existing operation stages. Define the smooth purity isomorphism as the recorded smoothPurityMap with its recorded invertibility proof; transport its source into the existing finite-Tor full subcategory. At finite, integral, rational and closed stages use respectively that map, the normalized integral trace transpose, rationalIso and commonIso on their actual twisted-pullback sources. Define finite quotient source comparison by scalar realization, equality of the actual quotient maps, finiteReductionSourceComparison and the unit comparison; rational and rationalization source comparisons are sourceScalar and rationalSourceComparison. Define the stagewise site-perfect predicate using the published predicates, and the inverse finite purity-square predicate. These are constructions and assertion predicates only; they assert no coefficient compatibility.

reviewed_lean.note: 7th delivery addresses the earlier RETURNs. Statement, proof and proof_deps unchanged; only lean and stmt_deps added. Each node's lean.statement is verbatim in its file. Fixed I binder: its unit gamma is normalized to RationalSmoothPurityCanonical.orientation via sourceUnitIso (core.unit pinned by unit_formula), and its reductions are equated with the finite smoothPurityMap. Forward and inverse squares stated for finite, integral reduction, integral extension, rationalization, rational extension and common stage, with the canonical source maps and the q-mates b. Explicit exchange equation TY.map e ≫ R_Q = δ_{Q,C} ≫ D_s(u_Q⁻¹) ≫ e' for site-perfect K at every transition, with admissibility as hypotheses; e pinned by StageConclusion.components. Oriented square: θ=homX.map(𝟙,γ⁻¹), c_H and R_Q^H explicit, three step-6 equations. ∃Package/∃StageScalar accepted: q and unit pinned, FieldComparison.b determined by q, free tensor/pull harmless (exchangeNaturality holds for all b; transport reduces to the inverse purity square); same interface as the landed fix-cor-verdier-exchange. Edge cases d=0, m=n, exponent 1, Q̄_ℓ via the closed/common stages, nonproper X all covered. No hollow definition; only sorry is the main proof; docstrings carry source, blueprint tag and all six steps. Advisories: cor-pur-adic-and-rational-smooth-dualizing-complexes (owner of modelScalar/commonInclusion) cited only transitively; per-stage exchange squares use p.unit rather than the datum unit; maxHeartbeats raised to 1e6 in one module.
